bio: The charismatic and heavily tattooed Guillaume Sanchez crafts fiery, flame-licked cuisine in a stylish arty interior, dominated by black and gold and a profusion of untreated materials. Sanchez’ powerful yet balanced score is emblematic of his flamboyant personality. The chef has a knack for wielding explosive flavours: spicy kimchi on red mullet, horseradish sauce on crushed langoustine or herby lovage oil drizzled onto a “trou normand” (a mid-meal palate cleanser). Cold-steamed extractions and fermented vegetables set the scene and the chef works exclusively with stellar, purebred Gallic produce, to which he adds his imaginative hallmark and high-flying technical expertise.
